notes: v401 — 🎓 New training lesson 32: 'Why the counts don't add up (and which ones must).' A sharp reader noticed a flag's price-up + price-down lines summed to MORE than the parent line's fire count. Not a bug — every line runs its own no-repeat clock (one fire per share per outcome window), so a parent line and its up/down siblings count clustered fires differently. The lesson walks the real numbers, shows the one split that MUST balance exactly (the 🟩/🟥 tape brackets), why sharing one clock would secretly bias the stats, and why longer outcome windows widen the gap. Find it in 🎓 Training. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
